text:
marta_marketing: Quick sync - partner microsite just confirmed a teaser mention for our upcoming 'Optimize' feature next Tue. Need one approved quote, embargo handling, and staging link for their copy. @jonathan_pr @legal_kate @oliver_social

jonathan_pr: Do we know if theyre running on an embargo? If it's a teaser they might publish before our full blog. We should request embargo until our launch time.

partners_ryan: Partner prefers to publish teaser at 09:00 PT Tue; they asked for a 25-word blurb and a staging screenshot.

legal_kate: Request: no unverified metrics in partner copy, and add a short IP clause in the partnership form about not implying joint endorsement. We can approve quote wording but need partner to sign.

marta_marketing: Draft quote: "Redwood Optimize helps teams reduce inference cost without sacrificing latency." Short and non-numeric. Thoughts?

oliver_social: Good. I'll prepare social variants once quote final. Also want a staging screenshot (low-res) we can approve for partner.

elaine: I'll reserve blog slot Tue 09:05 PT and social at 09:10 PT. CMS draft ready; will hold publish until you say go.

press_ops: Hold external outreach. If partner goes live early we'll use the partner mention as signal but wait for our blog to push full narrative.

jonathan_pr: Two asks: 1) Can we get preview rights on partner copy? 2) If partner declines embargo, we need to escalate to execs for a go/no-go.

partners_ryan: I'll ask partner for preview rights and the signed partner form. They usually accommodate.

legal_kate: I'll prepare a one-click approval template for partners to sign. Posting it here in 20m.

marta_marketing: Final quote posted: "Redwood Optimize helped our team lower inference cost while keeping latency stable." Legal?

legal_kate: Approved. Add: "Results may vary; based on internal testing." Please append if partner requests numbers.

press_ops: Noted. Partner confirmed preview rights and signed form. Teaser scheduled 09:00 PT Tue.

oliver_social: Drafts queued. Short X: "Sneak peek: were launching Optimize with partner [name]. More at 09:05 PT." Longer LinkedIn ready too.

elaine: CMS scheduled: blog 09:05 PT, social at 09:10 PT. I'll monitor and hit publish.

marta_marketing: Thanks all. I'll post "live" here when blog and socials are out. :rocket: 

press_ops: If coverage appears before our blog, we'll flag and pivot to reactive FAQs. Standby.

marta_marketing: Live: blog published 09:05 PT https://redwood.in/blog/optimize-launch and social queued at 09:10 PT. Closing thread. :tada:
